summary: CI: messaging_faults runs only in the daily long-lane run; pull requests and merge groups skip it through .config/daily-only.filterset, which scripts/ci-nextest reads unless CI_TEST_LANE=daily

replay.detail: CI test selection only; no product code changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No rule, checkpoint or coordinated upgrade change.

compatibility.detail: No protocol or API change. Required checks are unchanged; linux-gate still covers the remaining shards.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: Developers who run scripts/ci-nextest locally skip messaging_faults unless they set CI_TEST_LANE=daily.

recovery.detail: No persistent state; delete the filterset line to put the group back in every lane.
